name: attendance-aws-dev
install:
set -euo pipefail
TF_VERSION=1.9.8
if ! command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL -o /tmp/terraform.zip "https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TF_VERSION}/terraform_${TF_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip"
  sudo unzip -o /tmp/terraform.zip -d /usr/local/bin
fi
if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip"
  unzip -qo /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp
  sudo /tmp/aws/install --update
fi
terraform version
aws --version
